mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ai_answer_audit( public_id,session_id,client_request_id,prompt_version,model_name,intent, product_ids,citations,degraded,latency_ms,result_status,error_code,question,answer) VALUES( #{publicId},#{sessionId},#{clientRequestId},#{promptVersion},#{modelName},#{intent}, CAST(#{productIds} AS JSON),CAST(#{citations} AS JSON),#{degraded},#{latencyMs}, #{resultStatus},#{errorCode},#{question},#{answer})
mapper.select: SELECT a.public_id,s.public_id session_public_id,c.name customer_name,a.client_request_id, a.prompt_version,a.model_name,a.intent,CAST(a.product_ids AS CHAR) product_ids_json, CAST(a.citations AS CHAR) citations_json,a.degraded,a.latency_ms,a.result_status, a.error_code,a.question,a.answer,a.created_at FROM ai_answer_audit a JOIN chat_session s ON s.id=a.session_id JOIN customer c ON c.id=s.customer_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
